question: How can I get early access to Fern Scribe?
ground_truth: To get early access to Fern Scribe, which is currently in development, you can reach out via Slack or by emailing support@buildwithfern.com.

metadata.cited_context: Fern Scribe is in development. Interested in early access? Reach out via Slack or support@buildwithfern.com.
